Key facts:

- Member State: Switzerland
- Issuing authority: Federal Office of Metrology METAS, Certification Body METAS-Cert, address: METAS, Lindenweg 50, CH-3003 Bern-Wabern. Person responsible: Jürg Ramseyer, Head of METAS-Cert. Phone: +41 31 32 33 111, website: www.metas.ch
- Applicant: AQUAMETRO AG, Ringstrasse 75, CH-4106 Therwil. Manufacturer = Applicant.
- Certified type: AMFLO MAG Pro — family of electromagnetic flow meters intended for the metering of cold water
- Recommendation: R 49-1, edition 2006, accuracy class 2
- Date issued: July 1st, 2009 (CH-3003 Bern-Wabern)
- Test report: No 135-10705, 27 pages
- Page total: 4 (pages are marked 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4)
- CIML member: Dr. Philippe Richard, Vice Director

Description: family of water meters AMFLO MAG Pro covers nominal diameters DN25 to DN200 consisting of 10 nominal diameters. Nominal pressure 16 bar, maximal water temperature 60 °C.

Components:
- Sensor: Type MS 2500
  - Process connection: Flanges: ANSI, DIN, JIS
  - Flanges material: Carbon steel, Stainless steel AISI 304 - AISI 316 (optional)
  - Liquid temperature: 0°C ÷ 60°C
  - Vacuum resistance: 20 kPa (absolute) at 100 °C (60/80 °C for PP/Ebon)
  - Lining material: Polypropylene, Ebonite, PTFE
  - Electrodes material: Stainless steel AISI 316, Hastelloy, Platinum-Rhodium, Titanium, Tantalum
  - Version – protection rate: Compact – IP 67; Separate – Sensor IP 68 / Sensor electronics IP 67
  - Adjustment: converter corrects sensor linearly with k-factor
- Converter: Type ML 110 or ML 210
  - Upper part of housing AZ.020420.A1
  - Lower part of housing AZ.020421.A1
  - Software revision 3.xx
- Accessory components: none

Versions: Compact flow meter (converter and flow sensor fixed together), Splitversion (converter and flow sensor connected via cable).

Technical specifications table: 10 models by DN.

Table columns: DN (mm), Q1 (m³/h), Q2 (m³/h), Q3 (m³/h), Q4 (m³/h), Orientation, Disturbance, T (°C), Meter Class R, Length (mm).

Note Q(1), Q(2), Q(3), Q(4) — for water meters under R49 these are the four flow rates: Q1 (minimum), Q2 (transitional), Q3 (permanent/nominal), Q4 (overload). Q3 is bolded. Meter Class R 160 — actually for water meters, "Meter Class R160" refers to the ratio R = Q3/Q1 = 160. The "Meter Class" column with value 160 combined with header "R" means R160.

Models: DN25, DN32, DN40, DN50, DN65, DN80, DN100, DN125, DN150, DN200.

- nominals: DN25 to DN200, 10 nominal diameters

Recommendation: R49-1 → canonical id "R49", edition 2006, scheme A. Accuracy class 2.

Certificate scheme: OIML-CS. For certificates issued 2009, it's the pre-OIML-CS system, but the schema says scheme (A|B). Typically these are "A" for certificates of conformity issued by an issuing authority... The scheme field: for R49 certificates, typically scheme A. I'll use "A".

project_number: not present. Page_total: 4.

OIML issuer ID: not explicitly given. Omit.

Type designations: "AMFLO MAG Pro". Category: "Gas meter"? No — it's a water meter / electromagnetic flow meter. Category: "Water meter" or "Flow meter". The schema examples: "Load cell", "Indicator", "Measuring system", "Fuel dispenser", "Taximeter", "Gas meter". For this: "Water meter" fits best.

model_family:
- family_name: "AMFLO MAG Pro" (explicit family)
- models: one per DN variant. model_id: "DN25", ..., "DN200". Attributes could include diameter.

characteristics:
- type_level:
  - nominal_pressure: {value: 16, unit_symbol: "bar"}
  - maximum_water_temperature: {value: 60, unit_symbol: "°C"}
  - number_of_nominal_diameters: 10
  - nominal_diameter_range: {min 25, max 200} mm
- model_level:
  - q1, q2, q3, q4 (m³/h), length (mm). T and meter class R are constant → could be type_level. Orientation and Disturbance are constant strings — could be type_level as string values.
  
Per rule, model_level for varying attributes. Constant ones (T=60°C, Meter class 160, orientation H/V, disturbance U0/D0) can be type_level.

config_level: versions compact vs separate — that's a configuration axis. Version/protection rate: Compact version – IP 67; Separate version – Sensor IP 68 / Sensor electronics IP 67. This could be config_level with axis "installation_version": compact → ip_rating "IP67", separate → sensor IP68 / converter IP67. I could record protection degree in components characteristics or config_level. Let me add config_level:

{
  "attribute": "ingress_protection_rating",
  "axis": "installation_version",
  "values": [
    {"condition": "compact (converter and flow sensor fixed together)", "value": "IP 67"},
    {"condition": "split (converter and flow sensor connected via cable)", "value": "Sensor IP 68 / Converter IP 67"}
  ]
}

But the value must be structured... Actually in config_level the values follow the same structured form: {condition, value, unit_symbol}. For string values like "IP 67", value is a string. IP rating could have unit null.

Components:
1. role: "Sensor", type_designations: ["MS 2500"], characteristics: process_connection "ANSI, DIN, JIS flanges", flange_materials list, liquid_temperature range 0-60°C, vacuum_resistance 20 kPa absolute at 100°C, lining_materials, electrode_materials.
2. role: "Converter", type_designations: ["ML 110", "ML 210"], alternatives: "OR", characteristics: housing_upper_part "AZ.020420.A1", housing_lower_part "AZ.020421.A1", software_revision "3.xx".

matrix_tables: the technical specification table. Name: "Technical specifications by nominal diameter". Columns: dn, q1, q2, q3, q4, orientation, disturbance, max_water_temperature, meter_class_ratio, length. Units: mm, m³/h ×4, null, null, °C, null, mm.

Footnotes: Q(1), Q(2), Q(3), Q(4) headers have superscripts but footnote definitions not given in markdown. There are no footnote definitions present. Don't fabricate. The Q columns have (1)-(4) markers but no definitions; I'll keep column names q1-q4 and skip footnotes array or note. Better to omit footnotes since definitions absent.

Wait — the header "Q(1)" etc. — these might just denote Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 flow rates per R49 terminology, not footnotes. I'll treat as column names.

Test report: id "135-10705", pages 27, role: "test_report" (it says "Test Reports: No 135-10705 that includes 27 pages"). role: type_evaluation_report or test_report? The certificate says "associated Test Reports". The schema role options: type_evaluation_report | test_report | documentation_file | evaluation_report. Use "test_report".

Date issued: 2009-07-01.

Certificate number: "R49/2006-CH1-09.03".

Revision history: not present — omit. Actually software revision 3.xx is a converter characteristic, not cert revision history.

Accuracy class: 2. recommendation.accuracy_classes: [2]? Or "2"? For water meters class 2. I'll use "2" or 2. Use "2"? The schema doesn't specify. I'll use "2" as string or integer. Hmm, accuracy_classes[] — I'll use ["2"]. Actually number might be fine. Water meter accuracy classes are named "Class 1" and "Class 2". I'll use "2".

Module designation: not applicable field mostly for WELMEC Measuring Systems... For R49 water meters, could be null/omit. Omit.

Description: "Family of electromagnetic flow meters intended for the metering of cold water... covers nominal diameters DN25 to DN200 consisting of 10 nominal diameters. Designed for nominal pressure of 16 bar and maximal water temperature of 60 °C. Measures flow of electrically conductive mediums (water) by means of electromagnetic flow measuring system..."

Model attributes for model_family models: include dn, q1..q4, length per model.
